approved_known_issue_sources.title: DNS Cache Recovery - Guide 1
approved_known_issue_sources.body: If Wi-Fi is connected but internet access is unavailable, open Command Prompt and run ipconfig /flushdns. Reconnect to Wi-Fi and test again.

approved_known_issue_sources.title: Restart Network Adapter - Guide 2
approved_known_issue_sources.body: Disable and re-enable the Wi-Fi network adapter, then reconnect to the approved wireless network.

approved_known_issue_sources.title: Renew Windows IP Address - Guide 3
approved_known_issue_sources.body: For Wi-Fi connected with no internet, run ipconfig /release followed by ipconfig /renew, then reconnect to the wireless network.
